column1: # GATE-LIQ-079 calendar-EXCLUDED business days (DAEDALUS ask #5, owner-encoded 2026-09-29). Rule = the letter's own: ±2 business days (SOFR publication days) of each month-end (quarter-ends are month-ends) and of Apr-15 (next business day if Apr-15 is not one). Business day = a day the NY Fed publishes SOFR; holidays = Federal Reserve holidays (Sat holidays NOT moved to Fri, so 2027-06-18 is a business day). Every date NOT listed here in the window is NON-CALENDAR. Extend before 2027-06-30 (review_by carries it).
